request_timing.scope: Serialized worker request through private packet cleanup; excludes acquisition/GUI

scope: One persistent four-thread CPU worker per graphics mode; explicit preparation, one warmup and three measured calls per batch size, alternating order. In-memory capture before timing; acquisition, caller decoding and GUI excluded. CPU/RSS cover the launcher and owned descendants, not launcher alone. Core occupancy is summed process CPU / client round-trip wall time. RSS sums include shared pages; per-process peak working sets are cumulative and do not isolate individual batch sizes. Nested timings overlap. One shared workstation/scene, not general capacity or GPU qualification.
